claimBoundary: This is a shared UI and interaction readiness record. It is not a robot safety case, operating procedure, or certification evidence.

browserGate.note: Robotics Storybook representative browser gate passed against the rc.69.29 Core/Theme/Product candidate set.

stages.name: Monitoring
invariants: transport, freshness, operability, urgency, and identity remain separate axes
list and map selection share one target identity
stale or unavailable truth is not presented as healthy

stages.name: Operational control
invariants: authority and UI arm are distinct gates
deadman or continuous intent is required before movement
release, focus loss, unmount, link loss, and stop request converge on safe release
accepted, stopped, failed, and pending stop states remain distinct

stages.name: Alarm lifecycle
stages.reason: LDS has status and alert presentation primitives, but no verified product-owned alarm acknowledgement, escalation, suppression, or audit lifecycle is attached to this readiness record.

stages.name: Safety-certified HMI
stages.reason: Safety certification, risk assessment, controller validation, and site operating procedures are outside LDS ownership and are not implied by the UI contracts.
